entities.summary: Viktor Semyonovich Abramov is a Russian politician. He was a deputy of the 5th State Duma from the United Russia party. From 2004 to 2007 and from 2011 to 2016, he served as a member of the Federation Council representing the executive branch of the government of Tver Oblast; from 2016 to 2021, he represented the legislative branch of the government of Moscow Oblast.
